text: The Fed is now signaling possible rate hikes in 2026 while job growth collapsed to just 57K in June — this stagflationary mix (rising rates + weakening employment) raises the risk that economically sensitive and speculative holdings get hit hardest, so tighten risk across the board.
QBTS is down 28% with no earnings, 20% short interest, and insiders selling — cut this position significantly because the risk of further decline far outweighs any near-term upside.

IONQ is down 21% with no profits, 13% short interest, insiders selling, and ongoing cash burn — reduce your exposure now since speculative names like this are especially vulnerable if rates move higher.
ZIM has a negative PE, revenue shrinking 18%, and insiders selling — in a slowing economy with weak job growth, this cyclical shipping stock deserves a smaller position size.
NCLP.L is down nearly 18% with uniformly bearish technicals — trim this ETF position to limit losses while the trend remains clearly against you.
